symptom: The strict-v0 harness accumulated parser, release and canary machinery while the programme still lacked a direct deterministic episode replay path to prediction evidence. The user redirected the execution base to PredictionMarketBench and asked for a simple closed-loop experimental lane.
source_evidence: The official PredictionMarketBench paper and repository describe deterministic event-driven replay, AgentContext, order-book/trade/settlement episode files, maker/taker fills, fees and standardized PnL logs. The four public January 2026 episodes are already inspected and therefore diagnostic only.
objective: Freeze a concise, evidence-backed replan for minimal PMB integration, a first Train-only self-iteration episode, a fair Controller swap and explicit pause/retain decisions before implementation.
boundary: Read-only local reconnaissance and planning only. No provider call, paid sample, download, purchase, sealed-Final read, protected-state mutation, empirical run, release, commit, tag, push or other external write. Exact upstream SHA must be verified, never invented.
resolution_check: One integrated replan must name the adapter boundary, diagnostic episode protocol, prediction-first metrics, trading-after-freeze metrics, hidden-evaluator isolation, Controller-swap controls, paused legacy work, retained safety controls, implementation files/tests and unresolved authorization gates. A fresh independent reviewer must check the single integrated snapshot.

steps.action: Inspect local integration points and define the smallest adapter around an exact pinned PMB upstream without rewriting the replay engine.
steps.expected_artifact: A path- and API-specific adapter proposal with upstream-pin and focused-test requirements.
steps.verification: Supervisor checks cited local paths and confirms the plan delegates replay, maker/taker, fee and standard logging semantics to PMB.
steps.pass_condition: No simulator rewrite, no invented SHA, and a minimal deterministic contract covering prediction artifacts and PMB outputs.
steps.failure_action: Keep upstream integration blocked and reduce the adapter surface; do not fork the simulator to bypass uncertainty.

result.observed: Read-only audit proved the existing raw Kalshi replay and simplified taking diagnostic cannot substitute for PMB. It specified a separate thin adapter package, upstream/import/runtime verification and prediction-first tests. Supervisor independently resolved the official main ref to 611d66941717310858683278940df21c33c406f2 without vendoring it.

steps.action: Inspect existing isolation and validator code and design Train/Dev/hidden-Final separation with aggregate-only evaluator feedback.
steps.expected_artifact: A fail-closed evaluator boundary and threat/test matrix including untouched-date and settlement isolation.
steps.verification: Supervisor checks that Controller and Researcher cannot access hidden raw episodes, settlement or per-row results and that formal Final requires at least 20 untouched dates.
steps.pass_condition: Roles, paths, allowed outputs and failure behavior are explicit; public January 2026 episodes remain diagnostic only.
steps.failure_action: Do not build the empirical runner until an independently testable sealed boundary is specified.

result.observed: Read-only audit identified reusable one-shot, ledger, budget and credential primitives plus two concrete leakage mismatches in the legacy Controller/scorer path. It specified Controller=Train/aggregate-only, candidate=AgentContext-only, trusted-evaluator-private raw/settlement and a pre-open Final>=20 untouched-date gate.

steps.action: Design the Simple Episode Lane and paired GLM-3.5 versus frontier Controller swap using the same episode, tools, budget and five research rounds.
steps.expected_artifact: A minimal runner contract, paired comparison controls, diagnostic metrics and first-episode recommendation.
steps.verification: Supervisor checks single-episode lease, start/end snapshots, append-only artifacts, persistent Docker, no per-round global canary and prediction-first evaluation.
steps.pass_condition: The swap changes only Controller model identity and does not use a short-choice interface that masks research ability.
steps.failure_action: Keep the swap unrun and simplify the lane until equal treatment and reproducibility are mechanically testable.

result.observed: Read-only design specified five Controller decision slots, one persistent B, start/end snapshots, append-only artifacts, episode-wide accounting and equal paired-arm constraints. Exact Controller stacks remain unresolved; Supervisor excluded its legacy-NFL-first and supervisor_harness placement suggestions from the PMB integration.

steps.action: Integrate the three reports with the paper/repository findings and causal evaluation gates into one concise implementation plan and update the human redirect/progress record.
steps.expected_artifact: A single PMB replan with phases, metrics, boundaries, file/test map, blockers and authorization ledger.
steps.verification: Run link/path checks and compare every recommendation against the three worker reports and the prediction-first evaluation rules.
steps.pass_condition: The plan cleanly separates Track A prediction evidence from Track B trading, changes one causal stage per A/B, and names the next zero-paid implementation slice.
steps.failure_action: Preserve the reports and replan the conflicting interface before any code implementation or experiment.

result.observed: Supervisor integrated the official paper/repository evidence and three bounded reports into one replan. It pins prospective upstream commit 611d6694…06f2, freezes strict-v0, specifies a separate PMB lane, selects one public diagnostic Track A episode, separates Track B, defines hidden evaluation and four-episode Controller Swap, and records remaining permissions/blockers.

steps.action: Read-only review of the exact integrated replan for leakage, unsupported paper/repository claims, hidden multi-stage changes and unacknowledged execution gates.
steps.expected_artifact: A non-empty exact-snapshot PASS or REPLAN report.
steps.verification: Supervisor confirms reviewer independence, exact document hash, claim/source traceability and explicit remaining permissions.
steps.pass_condition: No sealed-Final exposure, paid call, public data acquisition or release is implied; diagnostic episodes cannot support formal OOS claims.
steps.failure_action: Keep implementation blocked at the cited causal issue and version a repaired replan.

result.observed: Exact-snapshot review matched d08c213d…d2f4 and passed the major direction, but found two P0 and three P1 gaps: hidden Dev was not separated from terminal sealed Final; source/episode fetch authority was ambiguous; aggregate differencing, immutable-spec enforcement, separate Track B identity and pre-open versus post-replay common-mask checks were incomplete.
